{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float, handling non-numeric values
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Filter for COMPLETED orders and exclude internal test orders
# Assume internal test orders are those with revenue = 0.00
completed_orders = sales_df[(sales_df['status'] == 'completed') & (sales_df['revenue'] > 0)]

# Calculate total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue = completed_orders['revenue'].sum()

# Confirm no completed orders have zero revenue (to ensure test orders are excluded)
zero_revenue_completed = completed_orders[completed_orders['revenue'] == 0]

# Output final result
total_revenue"}
